headline: US Wheat Futures Gain 1.4% While Soybean Prices Decline on Brazil Planting
summary: US wheat futures gained 1.4% while soybean prices dropped as rapid planting progress in Brazil weighted on South American agricultural export pricing.
why: Global grain commodity futures establish benchmark costs for commercial food processors, global grain traders, and international shipping lines.

impacts.name: Wheat Futures
impacts.why: Fund buying lifted US wheat futures prices by 1.4% during trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fast-paced soybean planting in Brazil pressured oilseed pricing, while wheat contracts recovered on short covering.
